label: Actual inquiry: report fibers, distinct belief targets and thin epistemic reasons
summary: Inspected the actual displayed seven distinct research labels and executed the complete pairing with residue 1991. In the eight-prefix finite comparison, the full report nonvacuously and strictly entails odd parity; the pair-only report fails to entail either parity answer yet entails cardinality six or seven. This supplies a different belief content even when the original question remains unsettled, extending the prior hypothetical suspension comparison. The observed data and reproducible Python tests distinguish truth, intelligibility, local validity, correction, evidence-relative merit, normative favoring and preference-independent force. The three structural force assignments vary force while keeping the interpreted evidence fixed; they do not settle actual authority. F1 and thin F6 retain their scope and legacy status. Reused 146b502b and the same-relation nihilism distinction, 6b4e3331's support calibration and b50727e1's selected-world population route. Proposed elementary Lean projections are not registered or verified. No source claim, graph change, proof registration, new floor marking or root premise discharge. See docs/notes/actual-inquiry-presuppositions.md for exact scope, controls, derivations, commands and handoff. Continuation from 4947b398: the present conscious questioning, when actually apprehended as such, supplies evidence for its occurrence independently of the external truth of its target. Unlike a report or verdict, that factive evidence-kind cannot be retained in a thoughtless comparison state. The twelve-state structural control and all 2048 actual-containing restrictions passed; 1024 retain the designated deceptive external counterpart. Eight basis-defeat profiles show the separate epistemic uses of one episode: external representational support can be undercut while present-occurrence support survives. Distinct basis labels do not establish that separation, actual acquaintance or independent warrant. The local SurvivingBasisGivesReason calibration remains a substantive application. This is a cross-family warrant proposal for e81971f1 and F6, with the existing Cogito bearer and esse bridges unchanged. No new registered result; the proposed witness projections remain unelaborated. Continuation from 10532a8c: weakened the factive-thought-access route to genuine phenomenal seeming, including nonveridical content and a different episode of considering a skeptical objection. The weaker present phenomenal existential survives either witness, but the thought-specific bearer consumer 08cef374 cannot accept the broadened Occurs interpretation. Tested 64 two-episode states, 2736 nonempty conditional-probability cases, 1440 accuracy-score comparisons and eight structural reason/force assignments in Python. Every phenomenal primary or challenge witness entails the weak occurrence; report-only and misclassification controls preserve the distinction from thought, actual uptake, and propositionally available evidence. Conditional probability is 1 given the actual witness event of positive mass, and correct acceptance strictly beats incorrect acceptance in the specified score comparison even when suspension ties. Neither fact entails normative force or a subject's warranted recognition of the evidence. The positive local judgment concerns a competent subject actually investigating whether any experience occurs, who grasps the available presented instance's existential bearing. A critic conceding a genuine belief-directed reason for the defeater already grants F6 for another content; withholding alone does not. No concrete rebuttal or lack-of-indicativeness mechanism preserving actual phenomenal presence and competent access has been identified. Higher-order defeat of access and the nihilist's rejection of reason-giving merit remain distinct. No new registered theorem or premise marking. Continuation from d84beef9: instantiated a credible higher-order assessor who challenges recognition of the actual evidence type. Explicit report profiles distinguish retained positive conditional bearing despite a lower joint posterior, neutralization, and reversal. Refining the same reports with actual A/D presentation preserves report marginals but gives probability one to the weak existential when conditioned on actual presentation, including adverse H. Classified zero joint mass and prior saturation separately. A mixed-channel apparent-access model gives strict support from any positive access-capable mode probability and sensitivity when a mode-independent fallback is neutral; an adverse fallback yields an exact threshold, and a dependent-mode control reverses the result even with a neutral fallback. These are stipulated probability comparisons, not a model of actual subjective entitlement. The strongest higher-order internalist can challenge the subject's credential to use a real basis even if actual presence and competent grasp survive; that is distinct from proving non-indicativeness or lack of all pro tanto reasons. Revise the overly broad reading that real occurrence excludes any higher-order defeat. A belief-directed reason for accepting the higher-order defeater or credentialing policy already grants thin F6 for a distinct content; suspension and nonnormative explanation do not. Existing introspection and regress results do not establish a universal credential requirement. Exact-fraction Python checks passed: three report profiles, 7776 positive-mass conditionings, 16 reason/warrant controls, 6561 mixed-channel sign controls and a dependent-mode counterexample. No Lean or graph changes. Continuation from ed293a13: separated availability and operative grasp, explicit metabelief, justified credential, reason for that credential, independent priority, and well-foundedness. On the existing consideration presentation of F6, the universal justified-credential condition C plus transmission to a strictly prior active reason T and well-foundedness W entail no reasons by well-founded induction, contradicting F6 under the same scope. This is an unelaborated application of the existing regress pattern, not a new registered theorem or independent defense of F6. A finite closed actual-use trace has a first use and cannot require a prior actual reason-use for every use; standing credentials outside the trace remain an escape. Distinct credential instances do not exclude cycles; potential infinitist availability is not completed prior use. The actual displayed item and the first-person phenomenal instance support an existential directly rather than merely stipulate it, differentiating a non-arbitrary starting ground from an unsupported hypothesis. Competent operative grasp need not be redescribed as a separately justified metabelief; shared direct grounds for both levels need not be circular. A general method credential alone does not supply the actual instance. Stronger internalists may require metajustification without independent priority or restrict credentialing to sufficient warrant, and infinitist/holistic accounts remain. The strict universal reasonless conclusion cannot be advocated with a genuine belief-directed reason under the same bundle. Container Python verified 4164 finite graph/active-set profiles, 2036 nonempty finite trace rosters, 16 status assignments and six method/instance profiles. No new source claims or formal registration.

The universal credential condition C, transmission to a strictly prior actual reason T, and well-foundedness W are distinct assumptions; F6 excludes their conjunction under the existing consideration presentation, not C in isolation or all infinitist/holistic epistemology. Need distinguish an operative grasp from a separately representable justified metabelief and assess its independent epistemic contribution. current_assessment.scope: Actual inquiry and the higher-order credential requirement for pro tanto belief-directed reasons; F6, well-founded dependence, and direct non-arbitrary grounds.
current_assessment.assessment: Under the existing consideration presentation, F6 is incompatible with jointly requiring a justified credential for every reason instance, a strictly prior genuine reason for that credential, and well-founded priority. The independently prior actual-use version also fails in a finite closed nonempty review trace. A separate justified metabelief alone is not refuted: direct metajustification, simultaneous or holistic grounding, and infinite dependency remain distinct escapes. The actual instance-to-existential relation provides a positive local ground rather than an arbitrary assertion; competent uptake can be distinguished from a separate certification belief. The ordinary local reason judgment is prima facie supported, not formally derived from information or occurrence alone. The strong credential bundle cannot explain away every reason while supplying a genuine belief-directed reason for its own adoption in the same scope. No categorical authority or ontic regress conclusion follows.
current_assessment.next_test: Test whether direct recognition of the bearing of an actual presented instance supplies noninferential entitlement to treat it as a reason without a prior justified metabelief. Compare operative grasp with a separately representable implicit credential on the same episode; require a substantive additional epistemic role rather than verbal redescriptions. Distinguish reason possession from use, prima facie merit from sufficient warrant, and direct grounds from independent prior credentialing. Apply a concrete misleading higher-order assessor; retain standing and infinitist rivals and the separate #930 force issue. Obtain independent challenge and full corpus preflight before registration.
